newsitem.title: USA: Woman says U.S. Army sergeant raped her eight times.
newsitem.headline: Woman says U.S. Army sergeant raped her eight times.

text.p: A woman soldier told a military court Wednesday that a drill sergeant used his superior size and strength to force her to have sex with him eight times while she was a trainee at Aberdeen Proving Ground.
The woman, whose name has not been published, told the panel that Staff Sgt. Delmar Simpson physically forced her to have sex with him repeatedly in the autumn of 1995.

In the fourth day of the military trial the woman soldier described details of the alleged events that took place in empty barracks and a room adjoining Simpson's office. Each time she physically and verbally resisted, she said.
"It was always the same ... I would resist and try to push him away. He would just put his weight on me and go from there," she said. "He was bigger than I am."
The defence argued that Simpson had consensual sex with women at Aberdeen.
The woman testified more than two hours about her encounters with Simpson, who was not her drill sergeant but who called her to his office frequently either to converse or to have sex, she said.

Despite having previously had sex forced upon her, she said she obeyed the calls to come to his office. Once she even hid behind his car's front passenger seat so he could sneak her past the guard, she said.

She described two occasions on which she said she spent the night with him and was forced to have sex. But she did not try to leave after he fell asleep, she said, because she feared he would wake up and also because she did not have any identification to get back to her own barracks.
She never reported any of the incidents because of "pride" and because of fear she would not be believed, she said.

Simpson, 32, was charged with 19 counts of rape and 39 other charges including indecent exposure, battery, and maltreatment involving 13 women. He pleaded innocent to those charges but pleaded guilty earlier to 11 counts of improper sexual intercourse with trainees and five of propositioning.

His was the first trial among the 12 soldiers charged in the military's biggest sex scandal since the Navy's 1991 Tailhook affair and he was charged with the most crimes. Four other cases were resolved through plea agreements or administrative proceedings.
